stories.headline: CUSTODIAN's ChatGPT relay moves to Firefox, then fixes message delivery and response polling
stories.summary: Two main-branch commits migrate CUSTODIAN's ChatGPT orchestration relay from Chrome to Firefox MCP and repair Send-button discovery, delivery confirmation and in-progress response detection. stories.body: The Firefox relay now connects Python scripts to an existing authenticated Firefox tab through Mozilla's DevTools MCP, without opening a browser or navigating to another conversation. A follow-up fixes selector drift that previously hid the enabled Send control, supports the current user-message marker to avoid false delivery timeouts, and detects response-starting state so the reader does not prematurely conclude that a reply is complete. The committed completion summary reports 17 unit tests passing, Python compilation, diff checks, a reader smoke test and a sender dry run. Those are reported local validations, not independent review or proof of an always-on host service. The separately published private WIRE pilot pointer was observed with a November 8 timestamp and is stale for current operational counts; none are imported.

stories.headline: Procgen ingress gets a coordinate fix for maps without a TileSet
stories.summary: A new main-branch change repairs tile/world coordinate conversions during TileSet-free procedural candidate evaluation and adds a focused regression test. A seed-123456 sandbox startup is reported, but broader validation remains unresolved due to LFS import and authored-level registry failures.
stories.body: Procedural generation can evaluate candidate layouts before a visual TileSet is populated. The ingress spawner now delegates tile-to-world mapping to the procgen tilemap's shared conversion contract, while reverse conversion uses the native 32-pixel structural grid when no TileSet is present. A focused regression covers positive, origin and negative tiles in both TileSet-free and TileSet-backed modes. The commit reports a user-confirmed manual seed-123456 sandbox startup, not independently verified full CI. Existing broader LFS import and authored-level registry failures still need follow-up. This landing does not prove independent acceptance, deployment or teardown.
bullets: Coordinate conversion repair landed on main.
Focused regression added to validation manifest.
Manual sandbox startup reported; full CI remains unresolved.
Next gate: run focused validation and resolve or isolate baseline-wide failures.

article.lead: CUSTODIAN has landed a targeted procedural-generation fix for an awkward moment in level creation: evaluating a map before its visual tiles are ready. The change keeps world entrances aligned with the same 32-pixel grid used by structural generation.

sections.heading: Why a missing TileSet matters
sections.text: The world ingress spawner previously relied on a tilemap conversion that assumes a populated visual TileSet. Candidate evaluation can run earlier. It now uses the procgen map's shared conversion method, while reverse lookup handles that TileSet-free phase explicitly.

sections.heading: A regression is in place, but validation is not finished
sections.text: A new test checks coordinate round-trips with and without a TileSet, including negative tile coordinates. The commit reports a manual sandbox startup for seed 123456. Broader validation still has LFS import and authored-level registry failures, so this is a landed repair, not a clean project-wide acceptance.

insights.title: The structural grid is now the common reference
insights.explanation: Using the same coordinate contract in ingress and procgen reduces disagreement between candidate evaluation and later rendered maps.

insights.title: A focused test does not clear unrelated CI
insights.explanation: The new regression is useful evidence of intent and coverage, but the outstanding broader failures still require an independently inspected validation result.

article.takeaway: A targeted procgen coordinate repair is on main; independent validation and broader CI disposition remain open.
article.next_watch: Watch for a recorded focused regression PASS and a clear disposition of LFS import and authored-level registry failures.
